name: simota-mods
description: Personal Claude Code mods: agent pane, quality gate, sandbox denial report, battle report, skill hints, TODO(agent) list

plugins.name: agent-pane
plugins.description: Live pane of the session's subagents: running ones with elapsed time, finished ones with result and duration

plugins.name: done-gate
plugins.description: Flags unverified edits, stops repeated failing commands, and blocks git --no-verify

plugins.name: sandbox-lens
plugins.description: Tallies sandbox denials seen in Bash output and reports them with /sandbox-report

plugins.name: battle-report
plugins.description: RPG-style battle report after each turn: tokens, edits, lines changed and tool errors, as a toast, a notification and a sound

plugins.name: skill-hint
plugins.description: Suggests up to three matching skills above the prompt from what was typed; never invokes them.

plugins.name: todo-agent
plugins.description: Collects #TODO(agent) follow-ups from Claude's replies into a per-project list with a /todos pane.
